You're the single point of truth for "is our tracking correct, and what is it telling us?" What you'll own * **Tag management (GTM).** Own our Google Tag Manager containers end to end — tags, triggers, variables, the data layer — across dev and production. Keep them clean, documented, and version-controlled. * **Web \& product analytics.** Own event tracking and configuration in GA4 and Amplitude — event design, naming conventions, funnels, attribution, cross-domain tracking, and self-referral/UTM handling — so the business has one reliable read on behaviour. * **Ad-platform \& conversion tracking.** Own conversion tracking across our paid channels — Meta (Conversions API / pixel), Google Ads, and offline/server-side conversion imports — so marketing spend is measured accurately and attribution holds up. * **Customer data \& Braze.** Own the flow of customer and behavioural data into Braze (and our wider customer-data stack) — SDK/tag implementation, custom events and attributes, external-ID/identity handling, audience segmentation inputs, and syncs from source systems. * **Reporting \& insight.** Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that the marketing and performance teams can rely on and self-serve from — and turn the data into clear recommendations, not just charts. This is an analyst role as much as an implementation one. * **Measurement framework \& governance.** Own the tracking plan — a documented event taxonomy, naming conventions, and data dictionary that the whole team works off — so measurement stays consistent as the business grows. * **Consent, privacy \& compliance.** Own cookie consent and consent-mode configuration (e.g. CookieYes, Consent Mode v2) and keep tracking compliant with POPIA / GDPR analytics, marketing, and personalisation tags gated correctly, with sensible data-retention practice. * *
